CMOS leaky integrate-and-fire neuron — nominal educational model
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 PWL(0 0 1u 3.3)
IIN iin 0 PWL(0 2u 100u 2u 100.01u 4u 200u 4u)
XDUT vdd 0 iin spike astra_014_cmos_spiking_neuron
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec tslow range 7.0e-6 8.6e-6 unit=s
* @spec tfast range 3.5e-6 4.4e-6 unit=s
* @spec pulse_width range 1.1e-7 1.8e-7 unit=s
* @spec spike_high range 3.0 3.5 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 1n 200u uic
meas tran tslow TRIG v(spike) VAL=1.65 TD=30u RISE=3 TARG v(spike) VAL=1.65 TD=30u RISE=4
meas tran tfast TRIG v(spike) VAL=1.65 TD=120u RISE=3 TARG v(spike) VAL=1.65 TD=120u RISE=4
meas tran pulse_width TRIG v(spike) VAL=1.65 TD=30u RISE=3 TARG v(spike) VAL=1.65 TD=30u FALL=3
meas tran spike_high MAX v(spike) FROM=30u TO=90u
write out.raw v(spike) v(xdut.mem) v(xdut.reset)
quit
.endc
.end

* Educational generic models by GPT-6-Astra. Not vendor or foundry models.
* Nominal 27 C; intended for topology/function demonstrations, not signoff.
.model ANPN NPN(IS=1e-15 BF=150 VAF=100 IKF=0.1 RB=20 RC=1 RE=0.2 CJE=8p CJC=3p TF=300p TR=20n)
.model APNP PNP(IS=1e-15 BF=100 VAF=80 IKF=0.1 RB=30 RC=1 RE=0.2 CJE=10p CJC=4p TF=500p TR=30n)
.model ANMOS NMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=0.6 KP=200u GAMMA=0.4 PHI=0.7 LAMBDA=0.02 CGSO=200p CGDO=200p CJ=100u CJSW=300p)
.model APMOS PMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=-0.6 KP=80u GAMMA=0.4 PHI=0.7 LAMBDA=0.02 CGSO=200p CGDO=200p CJ=100u CJSW=300p)
.model AD D(IS=2n N=1.8 RS=0.5 CJO=2p TT=4n)
